messages:
ashley: Folks — quick follow-up from last night's latency postmortem. I sketched remediation + tests we promised. Using this thread to capture owners & timelines so SRE handoff is clear.

mike: @ashley send it over, I'll own the load test + autoscaler regression.

ashley: High-level items (short):
1) Regression suite: synthetic QPS ramp + KV-cache warmup to catch cold-cache spikes.
2) Prompt-set regression: capture the 5 prompts that regressed in prod and add to eval harness with expected outputs.
3) Load-test gating: nightly canary/CI gate that fails if p95 > 400ms for our typical 512-token workload.
4) Chaos drill: simulate node GPU OOM and model fallback path + degraded-mode routing.
5) Tracking: surface remediation progress on the incident card and include run artifacts.

sara: I'll take prompt-set regression. ETA Wed EOD. I'll add prompts + a small unit test that asserts response latency < target and output sanity.

kris: I'll set up the chaos drill and the autoscaler failure scenario. Question: do we want this monthly or run on each major deploy?

mike: Autoscaler regression plan: create a k6 script that ramps to target QPS while intentionally blocking one autoscaler signal to reproduce the slow-scale case. Hook into a dedicated CI pipeline (build:regress). ETA Fri. Example command to run locally: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m scripts/scale_regress.js`

paul: For tracking — I'll create a GH project board and add columns: backlog / in-progress / validating / done. I'll link the incident card and set weekly reminders.

ops-bot: Incident-324: action items added: mike#415, sara#412, kris#418, paul#419. Next status ping in 3 days.

ashley: Owners/timelines summary: mike (load test & CI gate) — Fri 03/21; sara (prompt sets) — Wed 03/19; kris (chaos drill) — start sprint (03/25) with weekly runs for 2 weeks; paul (tracking/validation) — board created now. Let's do a 20-min sync Tue 11am to review progress and any early failures.

sara: Added prompt file and PR: evals/prompt_regressions/latency_incident_3.json — PR #412. Included expected tokens + a short note on why it caught the regression.

kris: Created chaos job playbook: ops/chaos/kv-cache-fallback.md and scheduled a weekly staging run for 2 runs. Playbook includes rollback steps and observability checks. PR #418.

mike: PR for k6 script pushed: #415. CI pipeline `build:regress` added, alerting to #eng-sre if p95 > 400ms. Also added a small warmup step to mimic KV cache priming.

ashley: Thanks team. Two asks before we close: (1) add a 1-2 line risk description to each PR explaining what failure this prevents, (2) upload run artifacts (k6 output, traces) to the incident card so validation is easy. After all PRs merge and a successful run in staging, we'll mark remediation validated and update the postmortem checklist.

paul: Created project card and linked PRs + CI artifacts. I'll ping here when validations are green.

ashley: Awesome. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here or DM. Otherwise see you Tue 11am. :thumbsup:
